title: Embed exact SEA build manifests
objective: Generate and embed exact sagejs.release-build-manifest-v1 receipts in Python-only and mathematical SEA artifacts with deterministic provenance and focused tests

handoff.summary: SEA assembly now creates and embeds canonical sagejs.release-build-manifest-v1 receipts for Python-only and native-mathematics executables, deriving target identity from the actual Node template and binding source, toolchain, math profile, native assets, and production-kernel authority/index bytes.
risks: Full SEA validation is owned by the release integration lane; this lane uses focused deterministic tests without constructing an executable.
The build intentionally fails if Linux binutils cannot inspect the Node template maximum GLIBC requirement.
next_steps: Register test/sea-build-manifest.cjs in the shared test manifest.
Tighten release-capabilities v3 validation to the exact embedded receipt schemas.
Run clean Linux and macOS SEA builds after integration.
